8.18.8. iLock_Geography.lcf.api.LCFWorkflow¶

class iLock_Geography.lcf.api.LCFWorkflow(railyard, importedLayout, useDefaultTypesFile=False)¶

Configuration object for for generating PiSPEC and populating LCF tables.

Parameters:
  • railyard (IRailyard) – Railyard to operate on.
  • importedLayout (bool) – Whether the railyard is imported (True), or comes from iLock’s layout editor (False). In the latter case, generated PiSPEC objects will be associated to the corresponding editor objects.
  • useDefaultTypesFile (bool) – Whether to use the type data that has been loaded by Prover iLock (typically from “Prover-iLock-config/Types.lcf” in the top package) or not. Defaults to False for backwards compatibility reasons, but users with Prover iLock 4.23+ are encouraged to set this to True rather than using addTypes.
